name: r51_internal_plane_trace_to_visit_binding
description: Group existing internal division traces by the nine actual coordinate planes.
mechanism: Each continuous same-color surface L trace identifies one actual internal coordinate plane crossed by PQ. Substitute the count of true plane transitions (4+2+3=9) for the count of cubes, omitting the starting cube. The query diagonal remains implicit; no diagonal or internal crossing point is drawn, and marks themselves are not counted as cubes.
primary_math_proof: Parameterize PQ=(5t,3t,4t). The 9 distinct crossing times are 1/5,1/4,1/3,2/5,1/2,3/5,2/3,3/4,4/5. Nine transitions plus the initial cube give exactly 10. All three counts and P/Q remain visible.

difference_audit.old: Own old projected_diagonal_count draws PQ, preset11, complete finals10/11 MISS. Related Solid155 old projected line10/10 MISS preset11; r40 boundary walk12 first-tested in46:10/11 MISS. All frozen failed PNGs excluded.
difference_audit.new: No PQ ink and no outer boundary walk. Existing internal seams are grouped into 9 real plane traces across adjacent visible faces; wrong unit is transition versus visited cube.
difference_audit.substantive_difference: Interior boundary ownership and missing initial cell, not 2D projected intervals or 12 unit edges.
difference_audit.preset_rationale_before_calls: 9 genuine plane crossings are mistakenly used as cube count; no old final9 has been chased.
difference_audit.source_receiver: The two visible face traces of each same coordinate plane are bound into one crossing event of the diagonally queried path.
